proves.claim: On a sprint board a landing that breaks a main test no import links to the item is pulled out with no hand command: the main-wide test job runs and goes red, the item reopens, and main on the trunk takes a revert with one pull-out job and one pulled event.

cli.sprint.main-break-pulls-out.why: Without the pull-out starter a red main-wide test only wrote pull_out, and the broken work stayed on main until someone ran a command.

proves.claim: The same break on a steady board queues no main-wide test job and no pull-out, and main is unchanged.

cli.sprint.main-break-steady-unchanged.why: The sprint wiring must leave steady boards as they are.
